description: Playwright CLI — browser automation and end-to-end testing (codegen, test, screenshot, pdf, trace viewer). Installs the npm package 'playwright'; the command is 'playwright'.
notes: Browsers are NOT installed with this package. Run 'playwright install' (all browsers, ~1-2 GB) or 'playwright install chromium' (just one).

They download to %LOCALAPPDATA%\ms-playwright, shared by build number with every other Playwright on this machine (project node_modules, VS Code extension, playwright-mcp) — same version is downloaded only once.
Common commands: 'playwright codegen <url>' (record a script), 'playwright test' (run tests), 'playwright screenshot <url> <file>', 'playwright show-trace <trace.zip>'.
